shortDescription: Configures the VxRail Manager IP address

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: gateway
options.description: The gateway IP for the new manager address

options.name: gateway_ipv6
options.description: The gateway IPv6 for the new manager address

options.name: netmask
options.description: The subnet mask for the new manager address

options.name: new_ip
options.description: The new IP address to assign to the VxRail manager

options.name: new_ipv6
options.description: The new IPv6 address to assign to the VxRail manager

options.name: prefix_length_ipv6
options.description: The prefix length for the new manager address

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for setting VxRail IP information, the default value is 60 seconds

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: The VLAN ID for the new manager address

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
